pending_valid_bodies_by_fixed_source.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_events e JOIN bm_bodies b USING(event_id) WHERE e.state='valid' AND e.compacted_summary_id IS NULL AND e.source=?
pending_valid_bodies_by_fixed_source.parameters: One fixed source enum per query; residual other=total minus allowed-source counts

failed_tasks_with_live_uncompacted_sourc.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_tasks q WHERE q.status='failed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bm_task_sources ts JOIN bm_events e USING(event_id) JOIN bm_bodies b USING(event_id) WHERE ts.task_id=q.task_id AND e.state='valid' AND e.compacted_summary_id IS NULL AND e.revision=ts.revision AND e.body_hash=ts.body_hash)
failed_tasks_with_live_uncompacted_sourc.meaning: Historical failed task rows with at least one still-live original source, not distinct pending events or currently eligible jobs

valid_summaries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_summaries WHERE state='valid'

current_facts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_facts WHERE state='current'

fixed_turn_status_counts_if_needed.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_turns WHERE status=?
fixed_turn_status_counts_if_needed.parameters: Fixed original production enum only; all unfamiliar values stay aggregated as other

compaction_eligible_event_count_at_verif.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_events e JOIN bm_bodies b USING(event_id) LEFT JOIN bm_turns t ON t.turn_id=e.turn_id WHERE e.state='valid' AND e.compacted_summary_id IS NULL AND e.reserved_task IS NULL AND e.closed_utc<=? AND (e.turn_id IS NULL OR (t.closed_utc IS NOT NULL AND t.closed_utc<=?))
compaction_eligible_event_count_at_verif.parameters: The same verified production UTC cutoff (now minus 300 seconds), twice. Do not silently substitute an unverified wall clock.
compaction_eligible_event_count_at_verif.meaning: Eligible event candidates, not tasks; original worker also requires global no-active-turn/idle/clock/lease guards.

fixed_scope_counts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bm_turns WHERE scope_kind=?
fixed_scope_counts.parameters: Count only; never SELECT scope_id/person_id/profile name.

connection: Root only: URI mode=ro, query_only=ON, BEGIN consistent snapshot; no Store constructor/import/migration/worker. Do not use immutable=1 to hide concurrent changes.
